import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 1000007;

    static char[][] board1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] mapping = new int[15][15];
    static int total_nodes;
    static int src, dst, time_limit, grid_size;
    static int zero_pos_x, zero_pos_y;
    static final int[] dr = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static boolean in_bounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < grid_size && c < grid_size && board1[r][c] >= '0' && board1[r][c] <= '9';
    }

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, cap, rev_idx;
        FlowEdge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            rev_idx = r;
        }
    }

    static List<FlowEdge>[] adj = new List[MAXN * 2];
    static int[] level = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] iter = new int[MAXN];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        adj[u].add(new FlowEdge(v, capacity, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new FlowEdge(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void expand_from(int r, int c) {
        if (board2[r][c] != '\0') {
            connect(mapping[r][c] + total_nodes, dst, board2[r][c] - '0');
        }
        if (board1[r][c] == '0') return;
        
        connect(src, mapping[r][c], board1[r][c] - '0');
        if (board2[r][c] != '\0') {
            connect(mapping[r][c], mapping[r][c] + total_nodes, 10);
        }

        int start_r = r, start_c = c;
        Queue<Integer> q1_r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q1_c = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2_r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2_c = new LinkedList<>();
        q1_r.add(r); q1_c.add(c);
        q2_r.add(zero_pos_x); q2_c.add(zero_pos_y);

        int[][] dist1 = new int[grid_size][grid_size];
        int[][] dist2 = new int[grid_size][grid_size];
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dist1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(dist2[i], -1);
        }
        dist1[r][c] = 0;
        dist2[zero_pos_x][zero_pos_y] = 0;

        while (!q1_r.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q1_r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int cur_r = q1_r.poll();
                int cur_c = q1_c.poll();
                if (dist2[cur_r][cur_c] >= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = cur_r + dr[k], nc = cur_c + dc[k];
                    if (in_bounds(nr, nc) && dist1[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        dist1[nr][nc] = dist1[cur_r][cur_c] + 1;
                        if (dist1[nr][nc] > time_limit) break;
                        if (dist2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                        q1_r.add(nr); q1_c.add(nc);
                        if (board2[nr][nc] != '0') {
                            connect(mapping[start_r][start_c], mapping[nr][nc] + total_nodes, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            sz = q2_r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int cur_r = q2_r.poll();
                int cur_c = q2_c.poll();
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = cur_r + dr[k], nc = cur_c + dc[k];
                    if (in_bounds(nr, nc) && dist2[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        dist2[nr][nc] = dist2[cur_r][cur_c] + 1;
                        q2_r.add(nr); q2_c.add(nc);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        level[src] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (FlowEdge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != -1;
    }

    static int blocking_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == dst) return flow;
        for (int i = iter[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            iter[u] = i;
            FlowEdge e = adj[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = blocking_flow(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    adj[e.to].get(e.rev_idx).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int total = 0;
        while (level_graph()) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = blocking_flow(src, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        grid_size = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        time_limit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            board1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            board2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(mapping[i], -1);
        }
        total_nodes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zero_pos_x = i; 
                    zero_pos_y = j;
                } else if (in_bounds(i, j)) {
                    mapping[i][j] = ++total_nodes;
                }
            }
        }

        src = 0;
        dst = 2 * total_nodes + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN * 2; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                if (in_bounds(i, j)) {
                    expand_from(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
